subject: [PATCH v2 12/17] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged test to run every supported collapse order by default, rather than requiring the user to specify a specific order. The test will automatically include all anon THP orders below the PMD context in both the no-argument invocation and the 'all' case. This change also updates the handling of the '-c' option, which now pins one order and reports an error if the specified order is above the PMD or unsupported.
